title: Maƙwabta
description: Ten short stories about neighbours and neighbourhood life in Hausa towns: a welcome with kola nuts, a torn uniform mended next door, a land dispute, street lights, a carver, a sick neighbour cared for, generator smoke, a long march, a prince opening a clinic and rats in a shared compound.

lessons.title: Sabon maƙwabci
lessons.summary: In the Fagge quarter of Kano, Saddam and his wife Zakiyya move into a new house and fear the neighbours will not like them; the next morning old Malam Abdulmuhsin knocks with kola nuts and dates from his own palm, takes them round to greet the other houses, and at the last house an old woman finds that Zakiyya's maternal uncle is her younger sister's son.
lessons.text:
Saddam da matarsa Zakiyya sun koma wani sabon gida a unguwar Fagge a Kano. Ba su san kowa a unguwar ba. Zakiyya ta damu, tana tunanin cewa wataƙila maƙwabtansu ba za su so su ba.

Da safe, kwana ɗaya bayan zuwansu, sai suka ji ana ƙwanƙwasa ƙofar gidansu. Saddam ya je ya buɗe ƙofar. Wani dattijo ne yake tsaye a waje, yana riƙe da wata ƙaramar jaka. Dattijon ya ce, "Assalamu alaikum! Sunana Malam Abdulmuhsin. Ni ne maƙwabcinku na gefen hagu."

Saddam ya amsa sallamarsa, ya ce, "Barka da zuwa, Malam! Shigo."

Malam Abdulmuhsin ya shigo, ya ba su jakar. A ciki akwai goro da dabino. Ya ce, "A al'adarmu, idan sabon maƙwabci ya zo, sai mu kai masa goro. Dabinon kuma daga itacen dabino da ke tsakar gidana ne."

Sannan Malam Abdulmuhsin ya ce, "Gobe da yamma ku fito, in kai ku wurin sauran maƙwabta. A unguwar nan muna zaune lafiya. Mun yi shekaru da yawa cikin lumana, ba tare da faɗa ba."

Kwana ɗaya bayan haka, da yamma, suka bi shi zuwa gidajen maƙwabta ɗaya bayan ɗaya. A kowane gida, Malam Abdulmuhsin yakan ƙwanƙwasa ƙofa, ya ce, "Assalamu alaikum!" Sai Saddam da Zakiyya su yi wa mutanen gidan sallama. Zakiyya ta raba wa yaran gidajen alewa da ta saya a kasuwa, kowane yaro ya samu alewa biyu. Yaran suka yi murna da alewar.

A gida na ƙarshe, wata tsohuwar mace ce zaune a ƙofar ɗakinta. Ta ce wa Zakiyya, "Zo nan, ɗiyata, ki zauna kusa da ni. Daga ina kika fito?"

Zakiyya ta ce, "Daga Katsina nake. Amma kawuna, wato ɗan'uwan mahaifiyata, yana zaune a nan Kano."

Tsohuwar ta tambaye ta sunan kawunta. Da Zakiyya ta faɗa, sai tsohuwar ta yi dariya, ta ce, "Ashe! Kawunki ɗan ƙanwata ne! Ashe muna da nasaba!"

Kowa ya yi mamaki. Malam Abdulmuhsin ya ce, "A ƙasar Hausa, kusan kowa yana da nasaba da wani."

Da suka koma gida, Zakiyya ta ce wa mijinta, "Na daina damuwa. Wannan unguwa tana da lumana, kuma ina da 'yan'uwa a cikinta." Da safe ta kai wa tsohuwar goro da dabino.

Tambayoyi:
Wa ya ƙwanƙwasa ƙofar Saddam da safe?
Malam Abdulmuhsin, maƙwabcinsu na gefen hagu, ne ya ƙwanƙwasa ƙofar.
Me Malam Abdulmuhsin ya kawo musu?
Ya kawo musu goro da dabino daga itacen dabinonsa.
Me Zakiyya ta raba wa yara?
Ta raba musu alewa da ta saya a kasuwa.
Wane ne kawun Zakiyya?
Kawunta ɗan'uwan mahaifiyarta ne, wanda yake zaune a Kano.
Me ya sa tsohuwar ta ce suna da nasaba?
Saboda kawun Zakiyya ɗan ƙanwarta ne.

lessons.title: Rigar makarantar Fatiha
lessons.summary: In Zaria, ten-year-old Fatiha climbs a neighbour's thorn fence to fetch a ball and tears her school uniform; she fears her mother, but contrary to what she expected, old Malama Hamisa takes her up the stairs, mends the tiny hole with soft thread, shows her the socks she darns for her grandchildren, and the next day Fatiha and her mother bring her new socks.
lessons.text:
Fatiha 'yar shekara goma ce. Tana zaune tare da iyayenta a saman wani bene a Zaria. Kowace safiya tana sauko matakala da gudu, ta tafi makaranta cikin rigarta ta makaranta.

Wata rana bayan makaranta, Fatiha da ƙawayenta suna wasan ƙwallo a titin unguwa. Sai wata yarinya ta buga ƙwallon da ƙarfi, ƙwallon ya faɗa cikin gidan wata tsohuwar mace mai suna Malama Hamisa. A gaban gidan akwai shinge na waya mai kaifi.

Fatiha ta tsallake shingen domin ta ɗauko ƙwallon. Da ta sauko, sai ta ji ƙara: wayar shingen ta yaga rigarta. Ba da sane ta yi ba, amma ta san mahaifiyarta za ta yi fushi. Ta fara kuka.

Malama Hamisa ta fito daga ɗakinta, ta ga wurin da rigar ta yage. Fatiha ta ce, "Ki yi haƙuri, Malama. Na tsallake shingenki domin ƙwallonmu. Ba da sane na yi ba."

Akasin abin da Fatiha ta zata, tsohuwar ba ta yi fushi ba. Ta yi murmushi, ta ce, "Kada ki damu. Tun ina yarinya nake ɗinki. Ki biyo ni sama, zan ɗinka miki rigar."

Suka hau matakala zuwa ɗakin Malama Hamisa. A cikin ɗakin akwai keken ɗinki da zare masu launi daban daban. Malama Hamisa ta zaɓi zare fari mai taushi. Ta ce, "Zaren nan yana da taushi, ba zai cutar da fatarki ba."

Ta duba wurin da ya yage. Ta ce, "Ramin ƙanƙani ne, ba babba ba. Babu wanda zai gane." Sai ta fara ɗinka rigar a hankali. Fatiha tana kallonta.

A gefen keken akwai wasu safa da dama. Malama Hamisa ta ce, "Waɗannan safar jikokina ne. Kullum suna yaga su a ƙafafunsu, ni kuma ina ɗinka musu."

Da ta gama, Fatiha ta duba rigar. Akasin abin da ta zata, ba ta ga alamar wurin da ya yage ba. Ƙanƙanin ramin ya ɓace!

Fatiha ta gode wa tsohuwar sosai, ta sauko matakala da murna. Da yamma ta faɗa wa mahaifiyarta labarin. Mahaifiyarta ta ce, "Ba laifi, tun da ba da sane kika yi ba. Amma gobe za mu kai wa Malama Hamisa kyauta."

Kwana ɗaya bayan haka, Fatiha da mahaifiyarta suka kai wa Malama Hamisa sabbin safa guda shida, domin jikokinta.

Tambayoyi:
Ina Fatiha take zaune?
Tana zaune a saman wani bene a Zaria.
Me ya yaga rigar Fatiha?
Wayar shingen gidan Malama Hamisa ce ta yaga rigarta.
Fatiha ta yaga rigarta da sane?
A'a, ba da sane ta yi ba.
Wane irin zare Malama Hamisa ta zaɓa?
Ta zaɓi zare fari mai taushi.
Me Malama Hamisa take yi wa jikokinta?
Tana ɗinka musu safarsu idan sun yaga su.

lessons.title: Takaddamar fili
lessons.summary: In Katsina, the teacher Malam Mansir finds Abdulhakim building a wall on the plot he bought, and the quarter splits between them; Abdulhakim keeps interrupting at the ward head's meeting, so they go to the land office, where the clerk Malama Wardatu finds Mansir in the register with stamped papers, Abdulhakim admits he seized the plot knowingly and asks forgiveness, and Mansir forgives him.
lessons.text:
Malam Mansir malamin makaranta ne a Katsina. Shekara biyu da suka wuce, ya sayi wani fili a ƙarshen unguwarsu, domin ya gina gida. Ya biya kuɗin filin, aka ba shi takardu masu tambarin ofishin filaye na jiha.

Wata rana Mansir ya je filin, sai ya ga ana gina katanga a kansa. Wani mutum mai suna Abdulhakim yana tsaye kusa da ma'aikatansa. Abdulhakim ya ce, "Wannan fili nawa ne. Na karɓe shi saboda kakana ya yi noma a nan tun kafin a haife ka."

Ba da daɗewa ba, takaddama ta taso tsakanin mutanen biyu. Unguwar ta rarrabu gida biyu: wasu suna goyon bayan Mansir, wasu kuma suna goyon bayan Abdulhakim, saboda shi ɗan asalin unguwar ne.

Mai unguwa ya kira taro a ƙofar gidansa domin a kawo ƙarshen takaddamar. Da Mansir ya fara bayani, sai Abdulhakim ya katse shi, ya ce, "Ƙarya yake yi!" Mai unguwa ya ce, "Kada ka katse shi. Kowa zai samu damar magana." Amma Abdulhakim ya sake katse shi har sau uku. Taron ya watse ba tare da an cimma komai ba.

Daga nan mai unguwa ya ce, "Mu je ofishin filaye, mu duba rijista." Da safe su uku suka je. Wata ma'aikaciya mai suna Malama Wardatu ta buɗe babban littafin rijista na filaye. Ta nemi sunan Mansir, ta same shi a rijistar, tare da ranar da ya biya kuɗin. Ta duba takardun Mansir, ta ga tambarin ofishin a kansu. Ta ce, "Wannan saye ya halatta. Filin na Malam Mansir ne bisa doka."

Sannan ta duba takardun Abdulhakim. Babu tambari a kansu, kuma babu sunansa a rijista. Malama Wardatu ta ce, "Kakanka ya yi noma a wurin, amma gwamnati ba ta taɓa halatta takardunsa ba. Idan gwamnati ba ta halatta takarda ba, ba ta da amfani a gaban doka."

Abdulhakim ya yi shuru na ɗan lokaci. Sai ya ce, "Gaskiya, na san haka tun farko. Na karɓe filin da sane, saboda ina ganin Malam Mansir baƙo ne, ba zai iya yin faɗa ba. Don Allah ka gafarta mini."

Mansir ya ce, "Allah ya gafarta mana duka. Ka cire katangarka, mu zauna lafiya." Abdulhakim ya cire katangar. Da mutanen unguwar suka ji yadda takaddamar ta ƙare, unguwar da ta rarrabu ta sake haɗuwa.

Tambayoyi:
Me Mansir ya gani a filinsa?
Ya ga ana gina katanga a kansa.
Me ya sa unguwar ta rarrabu?
Saboda wasu suna goyon bayan Mansir, wasu kuma suna goyon bayan Abdulhakim.
Me Abdulhakim ya yi a taron?
Ya katse Mansir har sau uku.
Me Malama Wardatu ta gani a rijista?
Ta ga sunan Mansir da ranar da ya biya kuɗin filin.
Me ya sa takardun Abdulhakim ba su da amfani?
Saboda babu tambari a kansu, kuma gwamnati ba ta taɓa halatta su ba.

lessons.title: Fitilun titi
lessons.summary: In a dark quarter of Kaduna where the power is often cut at night, an attacker beats and injures the night guard Malam Mahbub; the neighbours condemn the attack, the youth leader Habibullah collects money from everyone as each can afford, solar street lights are put up, and in their light the patrol scatters three thieves, catches the attacker, and the police crush his gang.
lessons.text:
A wata unguwa a Kaduna, babu fitilu a kan titi. Idan dare ya yi, duhu yakan rufe ko'ina. Ga shi kuma, ana kashe wutar lantarki kusan kowane dare. Bayan kashewar wuta, ba a iya ganin komai.

Malam Mahbub mai gadi ne a unguwar. Kowane dare yana zagaya titunan unguwar da ƙaramar fitilarsa. Wani dare, bayan kashewar wuta, wani mutum ya fito daga duhu ya kai masa hari da sanda. Maharin ya buge shi a kai da hannu, sannan ya gudu. Mahbub ya jikkata sosai. Maƙwabta suka kai shi asibiti. Yana jin raɗaɗi a kansa da hannunsa, har bai iya barci ba.

Da safe mutanen unguwar suka taru a masallaci. Kowa ya yi Allah wadai da harin. Wani dattijo ya ce, "Allah wadai da wannan maharin! Mai gadinmu ya jikkata saboda yana kare mu."

Shugaban matasan unguwar, Habibullah, ya ce, "Matsalarmu ita ce duhu. Idan muka sanya fitilun hasken rana a titi, mahara ba za su samu wurin ɓuya ba. Kowa ya ba da kuɗi gwargwadon iyawarsa."

Mutanen suka yarda. Masu kuɗi suka ba da kuɗi masu yawa, talakawa kuma suka ba da kaɗan gwargwadon iyawarsu. Mata ma suka ba da gudummawa. Bayan mako biyu, aka fara sanyawar fitilun. Sanyawar ta ɗauki kwana uku, domin sun sanya fitila ashirin.

Da dare ya yi, sai fitilun suka haskaka titunan unguwar. Kashewar wutar lantarki ba ta ƙara dame su ba, domin fitilun suna aiki da hasken rana. Yara suka fito suna wasa a ƙarƙashinsu. Fitilun sun haskaka har ƙofofin gidaje.

Bayan wata ɗaya, wasu mahara uku suka zo da daddare, suka yi ƙoƙarin shiga wani shago. Matasan da suke gadin unguwa suka gan su a cikin haske, suka bi su da ihu, suka tarwatsa su. Ɗaya daga cikinsu ya faɗi, aka kama shi. Ashe shi ne maharin da ya jikkata Mahbub!

Habibullah ya ce, "Mun tarwatsa su yau, amma 'yan sanda ne kaɗai za su iya murƙushe ƙungiyarsu." 'Yan sanda suka zo suka tafi da maharin. Bayan mako biyu, 'yan sanda suka murƙushe ƙungiyarsu gaba ɗaya, suka kama sauran.

Mahbub ya warke, ya koma aikinsa. Ya ce, "Raɗaɗin ya tafi, kuma yanzu ba na tsoron dare."

Tambayoyi:
Me ya faru da Malam Mahbub?
Wani maharin ya kai masa hari da sanda, ya jikkata shi.
Me Habibullah ya ce matsalarsu ce?
Ya ce matsalarsu ita ce duhu.
Yaya mutanen suka ba da kuɗi?
Kowa ya ba da kuɗi gwargwadon iyawarsa.
Me ya sa kashewar wuta ba ta ƙara dame su ba?
Saboda fitilun suna aiki da hasken rana.
Me matasan suka yi wa maharan?
Sun bi su da ihu, suka tarwatsa su.

lessons.title: Mai sassaƙa
lessons.summary: In Sokoto, the famous sixty-year-old woodcarver Malam Abdulwadud carves spoons and flat boards under a tree at his door and trains young men, among them his only son Yasar; the author Malam Mahdi comes from Abuja because he found almost no written records of Sokoto carvers, writes down everything for three days, and sends the finished book with their photos.
lessons.text:
Malam Abdulwadud yana da shekara sittin. Shi mashahurin mai sassaƙa ne a unguwarsu a Sokoto. Tun yana ɗan shekara goma sha biyu yake sassaƙa itace. Yana sassaƙa kujeru, ƙofofi, alluna da cokula. Cokalinsa na itace sun shahara a kasuwa.

Kowace safiya, matasa biyar sukan zo wurin aikinsa da ke ƙarƙashin wata babbar bishiya a ƙofar gidansa. Yana horas da su: yana nuna musu yadda ake zaɓar itace, yadda ake sassaƙa cokali, da yadda ake sa allo ya zama lebur. Ya ce musu, "Idan allo bai zama lebur ba, ba zai yi kyau ba. Ku ɗauki lokacinku."

Ɗaya daga cikin matasan shi ne Yasar, ɗansa tilo. Malam Abdulwadud ba shi da wani ɗa sai shi, shi ya sa yake so ɗansa tilo ya gaji sana'arsa.

Wata rana wani mawallafi mai suna Malam Mahdi ya zo daga Abuja. Ya ji labarin mashahurin mai sassaƙa na Sokoto. Ya ce, "Ni mawallafi ne. Ina rubuta littafi game da masu sassaƙa na ƙasar Hausa. Na bincika a ɗakunan karatu, amma ban samu rubutattun bayanai da yawa game da masu sassaƙa na Sokoto ba."

Malam Abdulwadud ya yi dariya, ya ce, "Ilimin sassaƙa ba ya cikin rubutattun littattafai. Yana cikin hannuwanmu. Kakana ne ya horas da mahaifina, mahaifina kuma ya horas da ni."

Mawallafin ya zauna kwana uku a unguwar. Yana kallon Malam Abdulwadud yana sassaƙa cokali, yana rubuta duk abin da ya faɗa. Ya ɗauki hotunan cokula da alluna lebur da matasan suka sassaƙa.

Kafin ya tafi, mawallafin ya ce, "A karon farko, za a samu rubutattun bayanai game da aikinku. Mutane za su karanta su ko bayan shekara ɗari."

Bayan wata shida, littafin ya fito. Malam Mahdi ya aiko wa Malam Abdulwadud littafi guda. A cikinsa akwai hotonsa da na Yasar. Yasar ya karanta wa mahaifinsa littafin da babbar murya. Mahaifinsa ya ce, "Shekara sittin ina aiki, sai yau aka rubuta sunana a littafi." Sannan ya ce wa ɗansa tilo, "Kai ma ka koyi aikin sosai, domin kai ma za ka horas da wasu."

Tambayoyi:
Shekarun Malam Abdulwadud nawa?
Yana da shekara sittin.
Me Malam Abdulwadud yake koya wa matasa?
Yana horas da su yadda ake sassaƙa cokali, da yadda ake sa allo ya zama lebur.
Wane ne Yasar?
Yasar ɗan Malam Abdulwadud tilo ne.
Me ya sa Malam Mahdi ya zo Sokoto?
Ya zo ne saboda yana rubuta littafi, kuma bai samu rubutattun bayanai game da masu sassaƙa na Sokoto ba.

lessons.title: Malam Bukhari
lessons.summary: In Bauchi, children harass Malam Bukhari, a mentally ill man the quarter calls a madman, and adults avoid him; the nurse Ihsan pities him, reminds the children that the Prophet taught mercy and that madness is an illness, learns he was a teacher who fell ill after his wife died, and gets his family to take him to hospital, where with treatment he calms down.
lessons.text:
A unguwarsu Ihsan a Bauchi akwai wani mutum da mutane suke kira mahaukaci. Sunansa Malam Bukhari. Yana yawo a titi da tsofaffin tufafi, yana magana shi kaɗai. Yara sukan bi shi suna ihu, "Ga mahaukaci! Ga mahaukaci!" Wasu sukan jefa masa duwatsu. Suna takura shi har yakan yi kuka. Manya kuma suna gujewa ganinsa; idan sun gan shi, sai su tsallaka zuwa ɗaya gefen titi.

Ihsan ma'aikaciyar jinya ce. Tana tausaya wa Malam Bukhari. Wata rana ta ga yara suna takura shi, sai ta ce musu, "Ku daina! Ba ku tausaya masa ba? Annabi ya koya mana mu tausaya wa marasa ƙarfi. Hauka ciwo ne, kamar zazzaɓi ko ciwon ciki. Ba laifinsa ba ne."

Wani yaro ya ce, "Amma Malama, kowa yana gujewa mahaukaci. Ba shi da haɗari?"

Ihsan ta ce, "Ba shi da haɗari. Gujewar da kuke yi masa ba ta taimaka masa ba. Abin da yake buƙata shi ne kulawa."

Ihsan ta tambayi mutanen unguwa game da shi. Wani dattijo ya ce mata, "Malam Bukhari malamin makaranta ne a da. Bayan matarsa ta rasu, sai hauka ya kama shi." Ihsan ta nemi 'yan'uwansa, ta ce musu, "Hauka nakasa ce da ake iya magancewa. Kamar yadda muke taimaka wa masu nakasar ƙafa, haka ya kamata mu taimaka wa masu hauka. Ku kai shi asibiti."

'Yan'uwansa suka kai shi asibitin masu ciwon ƙwaƙwalwa. Likitoci suka ba shi magani. Bayan wata uku, Malam Bukhari ya nutsu. Ya daina yawo a titi, ya daina magana shi kaɗai. Ya fara sanya tufafi masu tsabta.

Wata rana ya zo gidan Ihsan, ya ce, "Na gode, ɗiyata. Na ji an ce ke ce kika tausaya mini." Hankalinsa ya nutsu, kuma yana magana cikin nutsuwa. Ya ce, "Lafiya ni'ima ce. Sai mutum ya rasa ta, sannan zai san darajarta."

Ihsan ta tuna da abin da Annabi ya koyar game da tausayi, ta yi murmushi. Yanzu yaran unguwar ba sa takura Malam Bukhari. Suna gaishe shi idan sun gan shi. Shi kuma yakan ce musu, "Lafiyar hankali babbar ni'ima ce. Allah ya ba kowa ita."

Tambayoyi:
Me yara suke yi wa Malam Bukhari?
Suna bin sa suna ihu, suna takura shi.
Me manya suke yi idan sun gan shi?
Suna gujewa ganinsa, suna tsallaka zuwa ɗaya gefen titi.
Me Ihsan ta ce game da hauka?
Ta ce hauka ciwo ne, kuma nakasa ce da ake iya magancewa.
Me ya faru bayan Malam Bukhari ya sha magani?
Ya nutsu, ya daina yawo a titi.

lessons.title: Hayaƙin inji
lessons.summary: In Maiduguri, in the hazy cold season, the neighbour Alhaji Abdulrazak runs his generator under the window of Ikram's room and the smoke spreads inside; her two-month-old baby Afra starts coughing, the doctor Siyama listens to her lungs, asks about her urine, tells Ikram to keep breastfeeding and give no soft drinks or sugar water, and Alhaji moves the generator once he hears.
lessons.text:
Ikram ta haifi 'yarta Afra wata biyu da suka wuce. Tana zaune a wani gidan haya a Maiduguri. A lokacin sanyi, iska mai ƙura ta fara kaɗawa, hazo ya rufe gari. Da safe ba a iya ganin nesa saboda hazo.

Maƙwabcinta Alhaji Abdulrazak yana da babban injin wuta. Ya ajiye shi a jikin tagar ɗakin Ikram. Kowane dare idan aka ɗauke wuta, sai ya kunna injin. Hayaƙinsa yakan shiga ɗakin Ikram, ya bazu ko'ina. Ikram ta lura cewa iskar ɗakin ta gurɓata: tana jin warin mai a ko'ina.

Bayan kwana uku, Afra ta fara tari. Ikram ta damu, ta tafi asibiti domin tuntuɓar likita. Likitar, Siyama, ta saurari huhun Afra da na'urarta. Ta ce, "Hayaƙi ne ya shiga huhunta. Iskar da take sha ta gurɓata."

Sannan likitar ta tambaye ta, "Tana shan nono sosai? Tana yin fitsari kamar yadda ta saba?"

Ikram ta ce, "Tana shan nono, amma fitsarinta ya ragu."

Likitar ta ce, "Ki ci gaba da shayar da ita a kowane lokaci da take so. Kada ki ba ta lemo ko ruwan suga, domin jariri ba ya buƙatar suga. Ga wannan magani: ki narka shi a ruwa mai tsabta, ki ba ta da cokali. Huhun jarirai ba ya jure hayaƙi, saboda haka ki yi magana da maƙwabcinki."

Bayan tuntuɓar likita, Ikram ta koma gida. Wata mace daga gidan maƙwabta ta kawo mata lemo domin Afra. Ikram ta ce, "Na gode, amma likita ta ce kada a ba ta lemo."

Da yamma Ikram ta je wurin Alhaji Abdulrazak, ta faɗa masa abin da likita ta ce. Alhaji ya ji kunya. Ya ce, "Ban sani ba cewa hayaƙin yana bazuwa har cikin ɗakinki. Ki yi haƙuri." Da safe ya mayar da injin bayan gidansa, nesa da tagogin maƙwabta.

Ikram ta riƙa narka maganin a ruwa tana ba Afra. Tana shayar da ita kowace awa biyu. Bayan mako ɗaya, tarin ya tafi, fitsarinta kuma ya dawo kamar yadda yake. Ko da yake hazo bai tafi ba, iskar ɗakinsu ba ta sake gurɓata ba.

Tambayoyi:
Ina Alhaji Abdulrazak ya ajiye injinsa?
Ya ajiye shi a jikin tagar ɗakin Ikram.
Me ya faru da Afra bayan kwana uku?
Ta fara tari, saboda hayaƙi ya shiga huhunta.
Me likita ta ce Ikram ta yi?
Ta ce ta ci gaba da shayar da ita, kada ta ba ta lemo ko ruwan suga.
Me Alhaji Abdulrazak ya yi bayan Ikram ta yi magana da shi?
Ya mayar da injin bayan gidansa, nesa da tagogin maƙwabta.

lessons.title: Tattakin matasa
lessons.summary: The young people of a Gombe quarter go on a twenty-kilometre march to take books to the school of the village of Billiri; their path passes the town cemetery and sorghum fields, Bahiya makes them count their steps, a farmer's donkey carries their loads, they rest at the foot of a baobab where some swim in a pond, and the village school welcomes them with songs.
lessons.text:
Matasan wata unguwa a Gombe sun yanke shawarar yin tattaki zuwa ƙauyen Billiri. Suna so su kai wa makarantar ƙauyen littattafai, domin makarantar ba ta da isassun littattafai.

Aminuddeen shi ne shugabansu. Ya ce, "Tattakin nan ba wasa ba ne. Tazarar da ke tsakanin unguwarmu da ƙauyen ta kai kilomita ashirin." Kowa ya ɗauki jaka da littattafai da ruwan sha.

Suka tashi kafin gari ya waye. Tafarkin da suka bi ya ratsa ta gefen maƙabartar gari. Suka yi shuru suna wucewa ta gefen maƙabartar, suka yi wa mamata addu'a. Bayan maƙabartar, tafarkin ya shiga cikin gonakin dawa. Dawar ta yi tsayi fiye da mutum.

Wata budurwa mai suna Bahiya ta ce, "Bari mu ƙirga matakanmu!" Suka fara ƙirgawa: ɗaya, biyu, uku, har suka kai dubu. Bahiya ta ce, "Mun ƙirga dubu, amma tazarar ba ta ragu ba!" Kowa ya yi dariya.

A kan tafarki suka haɗu da wani manomi yana tafiya da jakinsa. Jakin yana ɗauke da dawa. Manomin ya ce, "Ina za ku?" Aminuddeen ya ce, "Muna tattaki zuwa Billiri, muna kai wa makarantar ƙauyen littattafai." Manomin ya ce, "Allah ya kai ku lafiya. Ku ɗora wasu kayanku a kan jakina." Jakin ya ɗauki kayansu har tsawon kilomita biyar.

Da rana ta yi zafi, suka huta a gindin wata babbar kuka. A kusa da gindinta akwai wani tafki. Wasu daga cikin samarin suka yi ninƙaya a cikin ruwan. Aminuddeen ya ce, "Ku yi ninƙaya a gefe kawai, kada ku shiga cikin zurfi."

Da yamma suka isa Billiri. Malaman makarantar da yara suka yi musu maraba da waƙa. Matasan suka ba su littattafai ɗari biyu. Shugaban makarantar ya ce, "Wannan balaguro da kuka yi ya nuna mana cewa kuna son ilimi."

Kwana ɗaya bayan haka suka koma gida a mota. Bahiya ta rubuta a littafinta: "Balaguron jiya shi ne mafi daɗi a rayuwata. Mun bi tafarki mai tsawo, mun wuce maƙabarta da gonakin dawa, wani jaki ya ɗauki kayanmu, kuma mun huta a gindin kuka."

Tambayoyi:
Ina matasan suka yi tattaki?
Sun yi tattaki zuwa ƙauyen Billiri.
Ta ina tafarkin ya ratsa?
Ya ratsa ta gefen maƙabarta, sannan ya shiga gonakin dawa.
Me Bahiya ta ce su yi?
Ta ce su ƙirga matakansu.
Me jakin manomin ya yi musu?
Ya ɗauki kayansu har tsawon kilomita biyar.
A ina suka huta da rana?
Sun huta a gindin wata babbar kuka.

lessons.title: Ziyarar yarima
lessons.summary: In Zaria, the quarter's run-down clinic is repaired with large sums from the Japanese ambassador; a messenger from the palace of Zazzau announces that the prince will open it, the women led by the nurse Malama Nabiha go shopping, heavy rain gets the visit postponed by a week, and in the end the prince and the ambassador open the clinic in its grounds and food is shared.
lessons.text:
Asibitin wata unguwa a Zaria ya daɗe yana taɓarɓarewa. Rufinsa yana zubar da ruwa idan an yi ruwan sama, gadaje sun lalace, kuma babu isassun magunguna. Mutanen unguwar sun yi shekaru suna kuka game da yadda asibitin ya taɓarɓare.

Sai jakadan ƙasar Japan a Najeriya ya kai ziyara Zaria. Da jakadan ya ga yadda asibitin yake, ya yi alƙawarin taimako. Ƙasarsa ta ba da maƙudan kuɗi domin a gyara asibitin. Da waɗannan maƙudan kuɗi aka gina sababbin ɗakuna, aka sayo gadaje da magunguna. A harabar asibitin kuma aka shuka itatuwa.

Bayan wata shida aka gama gyaran. Wata rana wani manzo daga fadar Sarkin Zazzau ya zo gidan mai unguwa. Manzon ya ce, "Sarki ya aiko ni in sanar da ku cewa yarima zai zo nan da kwana uku ya buɗe asibitin, tare da jakadan."

Mutanen unguwa suka yi murna. Malama Nabiha, babbar ma'aikaciyar jinya ta asibitin, ta jagoranci mata zuwa kasuwa domin siyayya. Suka sayi shinkafa, nama, mai da kayan miya. Wasu matasa kuma suka je siyayyar kujeru.

Amma a daren kafin ziyarar aka yi ruwan sama mai ƙarfi. Da safe manzon ya sake zuwa, ya ce, "An ɗage ziyarar zuwa mako mai zuwa, saboda hanyoyi sun cika da ruwa." Mutane suka ɓata rai saboda tsaikon. Malama Nabiha ta ce, "Kada ku damu. Wannan tsaiko ba zai cutar da mu ba. Abin da muka saya a siyayya za mu ajiye shi har ranar."

Da aka ɗage ziyarar, matasan unguwar suka yi amfani da lokacin. Suka share harabar asibitin, suka sa duwatsu a gefen hanyar shiga.

Mako na gaba, yarima ya iso tare da jakadan. Mutane sun taru a harabar asibitin, ana kiɗa da ganguna. Yarima ya yi jawabi, ya ce, "Na gode wa jakada da ƙasarsa saboda maƙudan kuɗin da suka bayar. Duk da tsaikon da aka samu, yau mun cimma burinmu." Sannan yarima ya buɗe ƙofar asibitin.

Jakadan ya ce, "Ina fata asibitin nan ba zai sake taɓarɓarewa ba. Ku kula da shi." Bayan bikin, aka raba abinci a harabar asibitin, kowa ya ci ya ƙoshi.

Tambayoyi:
Me ya sa jakadan ya ba da kuɗi?
Saboda ya ga yadda asibitin ya taɓarɓare.
Wane labari manzon ya kawo?
Ya ce yarima zai zo ya buɗe asibitin tare da jakadan.
Me ya sa aka ɗage ziyarar?
Saboda an yi ruwan sama mai ƙarfi, hanyoyi sun cika da ruwa.
Me matasa suka yi a lokacin tsaikon?
Sun share harabar asibitin, suka sa duwatsu a gefen hanyar shiga.
A ina mutane suka taru ranar bikin?
Sun taru a harabar asibitin.

lessons.title: Ɓeraye a gidan haya
lessons.summary: In a shared rented compound in Zinder where four families live in harmony, rats come out of a hole at the foot of the wall to eat the leftovers; one bites the boy Seydou on the foot, his mother Habsatou cleans the bite with alcohol, and his father Boureima gets the neighbours to stop leaving leftovers out and to set traps in every corner until the rats are gone.
lessons.text:
Boureima da matarsa Habsatou da ɗansu Seydou suna zaune a wani babban gidan haya a Zinder. A gidan akwai iyalai huɗu, kuma akwai jituwa a tsakaninsu. Suna raba tsakar gida, suna girki tare, kuma ba sa faɗa.

Amma wata matsala ta taso: ɓeraye. Kowane dare, ɓeraye suna fitowa daga wani rami a gindin bangon gidan. Suna cin ragowar abincin da mutane suka bari a cikin tukwane da kwanoni. A wata kusurwa ta ɗakin girki, Habsatou ta ga wani rami kuma.

Wani dare, Seydou yana barci a ƙasa, sai wani ɓera ya yi masa cizo a ƙafa. Seydou ya farka yana kuka. Habsatou ta kunna fitila, ta ga alamar cizon a ƙafarsa. Ta wanke wurin da sabulu, sannan ta shafa masa barasa domin ta kashe ƙwayoyin cuta. Barasar ta yi masa zafi, ya ƙara kuka. Mahaifiyarsa ta ce, "Yi haƙuri, ɗana. Barasa za ta hana raunin ya lalace."

Da safe ta kai shi asibiti. Likita ya ce, "Cizon ɓera yana iya kawo cuta. Abin da kika yi yana da kyau, da kika shafa masa barasa da wuri."

Da yamma Boureima ya tara maƙwabta a tsakar gida. Ya ce, "Ɓerayen nan suna zuwa ne saboda ragowar abinci. Idan muka daina barin ragowa a waje, ba za su samu abin ci ba."

Maƙwabtan suka yarda. Saboda jituwar da ke tsakaninsu, kowa ya ba da gudummawa. Wani maƙwabci ya sayo tarko guda shida. Suka ajiye tarko a kowace kusurwa ta gidan, kusa da gindin bango. Kowace iyali ta yi alƙawarin rufe ragowar abincinta a cikin tukunya.

Da daddare, tarkon ya kama ɓeraye uku. Bayan mako ɗaya, sun kama goma. Daga nan suka toshe ramukan da ke gindin bangon da ƙasa da duwatsu. Bayan haka, ba a sake ganin ɓera a gidan ba.

Seydou ya warke, kuma ba ya tsoron barci a ƙasa. Boureima ya ce wa maƙwabtansa, "Kun ga, jituwa ita ce maganin matsalolinmu."

Tambayoyi:
Daga ina ɓerayen suke fitowa?
Suna fitowa daga wani rami a gindin bangon gidan.
Me ɓerayen suke ci?
Suna cin ragowar abincin da mutane suka bari.
Me Habsatou ta yi bayan ɓera ya yi wa Seydou cizo?
Ta wanke wurin da sabulu, sannan ta shafa masa barasa.
Ina maƙwabtan suka ajiye tarko?
Sun ajiye tarko a kowace kusurwa ta gidan, kusa da gindin bango.
Me Boureima ya ce shi ne maganin matsalolinsu?
Ya ce jituwa ita ce maganin matsalolinsu.
